LOOK: Fisherfolk, Indigenous communities, and environmental advocates, under the banners of Pambansang Lakas ng Kilusang Mamamalakaya ng Pilipinas (PAMALAKAYA) and Kalikasan People’s Network for the Environment (KPNE), rally at the Supreme Court on Thursday, June 5, in observance of World Environment Day.

The demonstrators condemn recent Supreme Court decisions that they say will accelerate environmental degradation and exploitation. These include the ruling permitting commercial fishing vessels to operate within the 15-kilometer municipal waters and the lifting of the 25-year mining moratorium in Occidental Mindoro. 

📸: Mark Balmores | MB
